canonical_project: NHN Cloud Gwangju AI Data Center (National AI Data Center)
notes: National AI Data Center at Oryong-dong, Buk-gu (near GIST); NHN selected Feb 2021 to build/operate cloud infra; operational, minister (MSIT) visits 2025; part of national AI computing ramp (GPU expansion, 18,000 GPUs by 2026). Government-NHN operated AI facility.
